page.overview:
Who is Dorin Bell?

Dorin Bell was a male human scientist who served the Galactic Empire. Around 6 BBY, Bell was the first target for Jyn Erso to assassinate on the planet Horuz. However, he was killed not by Erso's weapon, but by a grenade from a trap set up by the Partisans in case of Erso's failure.
